messages:
maria: Heads-up: CI red on PR #4321 (feature/kv-evict). Failing on pyright + eslint after the tsconfig refactor, and there's a flaky macOS test: test_kvcache_eviction. Logs: https://ci.internal/red/4321 :facepalm:
ci-bot: build failed on ubuntu-latest and macos-latest — test_kvcache_eviction errored on macOS, pyright errors in /web/src/cache/*.ts, eslint > prettier/style mismatch in web/tsconfig.json rule.
sam: Can someone rerun macos? if it's EOL-related it often shows only on macos runners.
jen: I can take a quick bisect if nobody has started. If it's a tsconfig slip, bisect should show which infra/tsconfig change introduced the type errors.
anika: FYI I hit a similar eslint+prettier break yesterday — adding a .gitattributes + normalizing line endings in generated fixtures fixed it for me. Also prettier moved to plugin order in eslint config.
leo: Queued a macOS rerun now. macos job id 98765.
sam: thanks leo. if rerun reproduces, jen can bisect; if not, maybe flake.
jen: starting bisect. local steps:
```
git checkout feature/kv-evict
git bisect start HEAD origin/main
# mark bad at HEAD
git bisect bad
# mark good around 2 commits back when CI was green
git bisect good <sha_good>
# run the test+typecheck script
./scripts/ci/check-types-and-tests.sh
```
I’ll post results.
anika: also check .gitattributes contains: 
```
*.ts text eol=lf
web/** text=auto
```
some generated files were committed with CRLF last week.
jen: bisect update — narrowed to commit 8a9f3d2 which altered web/tsconfig.base.json (changed strictNullChecks & baseUrl). Reverting that file locally makes both pyright and eslint pass for me.
maria: interesting — 8a9f3d2 was an infra tidy by @infra-batch that aimed to unify baseUrl. I'll open a revert PR for now.
sam: if revert fixes it, we should patch tsconfig change more conservatively. Also let's add a CI check for line endings in the web/fixtures dir.
leo: macos rerun finished: same failure on macos 1/1 — so not purely flakey.
eng-sre-bot: Runner health check: macos-runner-3 had high disk usage ~90% around the job; runner restarted. Noted in incident log #321.
jen: created bisect notes and pushed branch bisect/pyright-8a9f3d2; test runner reproducible locally and in ubuntu when tsconfig reverted.
maria: opened PR #4330 to revert the tsconfig base change and added .gitattributes + pre-commit hook update to normalize fixtures. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4330
anika: nice. once PR merges, we should request a full CI sweep and then re-enable the stricter tsconfig change behind a feature toggle in infra repo.
sam: can we also add a short docs blurb about committing generated files and eol? saves future time.
maria: added a short blurb in dev-docs/commits.md in PR #4330.
jen: closing the bisect thread — leaving tag [bisect-complete] on the PR. Thanks everyone. :tada:
maria: thanks all :heart:
